correctness.rationale: The proof reconstructs the actual published constructor. The half-turn \((x,y,z)\mapsto(2|w|-x,y,-z)\) reverses generator order while preserving each positive Artin generator because the reversed step starts with the exchanged lane occupants and the z-sign flip restores the over/under convention. The interpolation and bump identities are exact. Since each A or B block is two identical generators, block reversal is word reversal. Boundary vertices, side couplings, spacers and all three symmetric closure routes are mapped exactly. The map is an orientation-preserving rigid rotation and hence an ambient-isotopy endpoint. Burnside's lemma then gives the orbit count. A standalone coordinate replay checked all 2047 words through length ten without a mismatch.

originality.rationale: The primary paper states order sensitivity and explicitly exhibits equal Yamada polynomials for AAB and BAA, while the public audit already records finite reversal equality. This finite observation is therefore not claimed as new. The new claim is the all-word ambient-isotopy theorem, its explicit rigid rotation, and the exact reversal-orbit quotient. The source certificate explicitly marks the all-word realization as unproved, and neither the paper text nor repository searches state the geometric reversal theorem.
residual_risks: The geometric reversal equivalence may be regarded as an elementary consequence of the constructor once noticed, despite not being stated in the inspected source.
An unindexed note or later repository revision could contain the same all-word half-turn argument.
The theorem depends on the exact source constructor; changing the host closure or replacing pure-square blocks by non-palindromic blocks can destroy the symmetry.

value.rationale: The result upgrades a finite invariant-level pattern already present in the source audit to an exact all-word statement about the spatial embeddings themselves. It explains the source's AAB=BAA example without invoking the transfer reconstruction, identifies a genuine geometric redundancy in an explicitly order-sensitive family, and gives an exact reversal-orbit reduction for any exhaustive or learning-based search over braid words. This is a structural lemma rather than a recomputation of the existing data.
